name: ado-exporter
description: Prometheus exporter for Azure DevOps pipeline/pool metrics and (optionally) GitHub repo activity. Polls each API read-only and exposes the results in Prometheus text format. GitHub metrics are optional - leave GITHUB_OWNER blank and skip the github-token mount to run ADO-only.

paths.name: ado-pat
paths.description: Read-only bind mount to a file containing your Azure DevOps PAT (do not put the PAT directly in a Variable).

paths.name: github-token
paths.description: Optional. Read-only bind mount to a file containing a GitHub token, only used if GITHUB_OWNER is set.

variables.name: ADO_ORG
variables.description: Your Azure DevOps org URL, e.g. https://dev.azure.com/your-org

variables.name: GITHUB_OWNER
variables.description: Optional. GitHub user/org to pull repo metrics for. Leave blank to disable GitHub metrics entirely.
